name: Zelefin
description: Companion plugin for the Zelefin iOS and Android apps. Pushes Seerr and skip defaults to every install, and sends lock-screen notifications when titles are added.
overview: Companion plugin for the Zelefin iOS and Android apps

versions.changelog: User messages: a dashboard DisplayMessage reaches every Zelefin install for that user, including a closed app.
Android support: Zelefin on Android registers with the plugin and gets the same lock-screen alerts as iPhone and iPad.
Initial release: Seerr defaults, Intro Skipper lock, and iPhone notifications through Zelefin’s push service.
